description: CodeLab Capital AS, an investment company, focuses on supporting tech companies in Norway and internationally. The company offers PatientSky, Programvareforlaget, Hove Medical, Infodoc, and Kuba, which are electronic health platforms, as well as PatientSky App, a healthcare communication application. It also provides Cloudya, a service that operates as a partner of Amazon Web Services. The company was formerly known as PatientSky Group AS and changed its name to CodeLab Capital AS in May 2023. CodeLab Capital AS was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Trondheim, Norway.
